title: Project management basics for analytical deliverables

videos.script: Marina's first attempt took three weeks and produced thirty-eight slides nobody acted on. Her second took seven weeks and produced a pilot. {{two}} The second was not better analysis. The data and the method were the same. It was better managed. {{managed}} It started from the decision, not the data. It delivered a rough answer in the first week. It had dates, and somebody who knew when each one slipped. {{started}} And at the end, everything in it could be run again by somebody else. {{again}} This lesson is the minimum project management an analytical deliverable needs. Not a methodology. Five habits that decide whether good analysis arrives in time to matter. {{habits}}
